company.name: Bluecrew
company.shortDescription: Bluecrew is Your On-Demand Staffing Solution
company.description:
BlueCrew is an on-demand staffing platform for temporary workers. They are looking to change the future of work by adding transparency and automation to the staffing of blue collar positions. They are the best platform to quickly fill short term, low complexity positions with high quality candidates.

They offer theircustomers the flexibility of a mobile-based staffing platform, with the benefits of the legal protections from a traditional w2 staffing model.

productsAndServices.description: A workforce-as-a-service platform providing on-demand access to pre-screened, W-2 hourly workers to flexibly scale teams based on variable demand.
productsAndServices.name: Elastic Hourly Workforce

productsAndServices.description: A service that onboards client-provided workers as W-2 employees of Bluecrew, managing their payroll, benefits, and compliance while placing them on client schedules for long-term assignments.

productsAndServices.description: A technology platform that supports recruiting, scheduling, time tracking, compliance, payroll, and analytics for managing hourly W-2 workers.

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows workers to access a portion of their earned wages before the regular payday for a small fee.
